_comment: FREE-FLIGHT (rigless) tune — IN PROGRESS, converging by hand-flight. Started from the GCS autotune gains (too soft -> tipped), stiffening roll/pitch rate kp by binary search: 0.001 too soft, 0.004 flew but oscillated, now trying 0.0025. yaw needed its integral restored (default heading-hold). The geometry sign fix is REQUIRED (default spin-sign backwards -> yaw positive feedback). All live-only; re-apply after each battery cycle with tools/sysid/apply_tune.py.
airframe: X-quad free flight. M1,M3 CW, M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned.

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default -> flips s_mix_yaw only. REQUIRED for free flight.

rate_pid._comment: roll/pitch rate kp 0.004 (moderate inner loop), kd on the actuator pole, low ki knee. yaw: firmware default WITH integral (heading hold).

angle_pid._comment: OUTER loop SOFTENED to 1.0 (was 4.317) — the autotune angle_kp was faster than the soft inner loop -> ~1 Hz cascade oscillation. Outer must be slower than inner.
